basic_details.job_title: AVNL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Manager, Senior Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL), a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, has advertised 3 posts on fixed term employment: 1 Manager (OL) and 2 Senior Manager (HR), under Advt. No. AVNL/CO/HR/2026/08. Eligible Indian Nationals must send the filled application by Speed Post/Courier Service to The General Manager/HR-II (CO), Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited, HVF Road, Avadi, Chennai – 600 054. The application must be received at AVNL CO within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

content_sections.heading: About AVNL
content_sections.text: Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited describes itself as a new Defence Public Sector Company with its headquarters at Avadi (Chennai). Its units include Heavy Vehicles Factory, Avadi; Engine Factory Avadi; Vehicle Factory Jabalpur; Ordnance Factory Medak; Machine Tool Prototype Factory, Ambernath; two Design and Development Centres; AVNL Institutes of Learning at Avadi, Medak and Ambernath; and Liaison Offices at New Delhi and Pune. AVNL manufactures Main Battle Tanks, Infantry Combat Vehicles, support vehicles and defence mobility solutions for the armed forces and domestic security agencies. The notice states that both posts are within the Human Resources department, and selected candidates will be posted to the Units/offices of AVNL.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through SBI Collect (PSU -> Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (Tamil Nadu) -> AVNL CO -> Recruitment fees) or by a Demand Draft drawn in favour of Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited, payable at Chennai. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates should check their eligibility before paying. The form has a column (item 14) for the fee mode, DD number, DD date and bank details.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates claiming a category must hold a valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD certificate from the Competent Authority, in the latest prescribed format of the Government of India. Experience must be in a full time job on regular salary basis, after acquiring the prescribed minimum essential educational qualification. For intermittent jobs, only the actual days engaged in full time work are counted. Freelance experience and entrepreneurial experience are not considered. Articleship / Internship / Academic Project / Teaching / Research experience is not considered as post-qualification experience. On-the-job training as Management Trainee (MT) / Executive Trainee (ET) / Graduate Trainee (GT) in PSUs after the requisite qualification, and apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, are counted. A Large Private Sector Organization / Company of Repute means a company listed on NSE or group A & B of BSE, OR one with more than 500 employees, OR one with an annual turnover of more than Rs.250 Crores in the last financial year. In addition, the notice provides Annual Increment @3%, Earned Leave @18 days per annum and 10 Casual Leave, PF and Gratuity. Employees on fixed term employment get in-patient medical treatment for self and family members (spouse and two living children) during the engagement; these facilities cease on discontinuation. Apart from these, contract employees are not eligible for any other benefit or facility. The notice does not print the IDA amount. The tenure is ONE year from the date of appointment and ends automatically on completion, without further notice. It may be extended up to a maximum of four years (including the initial period), based on requirement and individual performance, with the approval of the Head of the Unit. Extension beyond 4 years may also be considered with the approval of AVNL Corporate Office.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Class X passing Certificate / Mark sheet, PAN Card and Aadhaar Card as proof of Name and DOB (Name and DOB should match on all documents). Caste / disability certificate for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS candidates, as applicable. OBC-NCL certificate in central format for the current financial year (FY 2026-27). EWS: current year Income & Asset certificate in the prescribed format, valid for FY 2026-27 based on the income of FY 2025-26. Disability certificate in the latest central Govt. format generated online through the Swavalamban / UDID portal, showing the type and percentage of disability. Master's/Bachelor's Degree Certificate (Provisional / Final). Past employment: work experience certificate showing date of joining, date of relieving, pay last drawn, pay scale with duration and nature of jobs / areas of experience / projects handled – compulsory for every past employment listed in the form. Current employment: Experience Certificate with these details, OR an Offer/Appointment letter showing the date of joining, OR an Offer/Appointment letter with another employer document (pay slip / identity card) showing the date of joining. Proof of continuity of present employment: latest pay slips for three months. A self-declaration about the nature of jobs or projects handled will not be accepted, and non-submission of experience documents may lead to rejection. Applications without the required documents will be treated as incomplete and rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination for the Manager and Senior Manager posts. Applications are screened by a Screening Committee, and shortlisted candidates make a presentation before the selection committee on their achievements so far and a vision statement for the job applied, followed by an interview. The Company may adopt higher criteria if many eligible applications are received. The interview will be held at Avadi, Chennai or through Video Conference (VC) mode, depending on the number of eligible applicants. Names of candidates shortlisted for interview and final selections will be notified on the AVNL website. The selection process is tentative and may vary with the number of applicants and the Company's requirements. Engagements are recommended by a Selection Board constituted by the concerned Head of the Unit/Corporate Office. Selected candidates are subject to verification of qualifications, category/disability certificate, experience certificate and character and antecedents, and the appointment depends on being declared "MEDICALLY FIT" by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be processed as per vacancies available in different units of AVNL. AVNL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the number of vacancies without further notice. Any variation in Name / Surname / Spelling between the application and certificates makes the application liable to be cancelled. Give an active email address and mobile number; all important communications will be sent there. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage, the candidature stands cancelled; if detected after appointment, contract services are liable to be terminated without notice. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate. Disputes can be instituted only in Chennai, and courts/tribunals/forums at Chennai have sole jurisdiction.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AVNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 01 Manager (OL) [UR] and 02 Senior Manager (HR) [01 UR, 01 OBC].

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received at AVNL CO within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AVNL Manager (OL)?
faq.answer: A First Class full time Master's degree in Hindi, English or any subject with the Hindi/English combination at Bachelor's level as specified, plus a recognised Diploma in Translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa, with minimum 7 years' post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper limit is 35 years for Manager (OL) and 45 years for Senior Manager (HR), as on the closing date of the advertisement, with 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL and 10 years for PwBD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for AVNL Senior Manager (HR)?
faq.answer: Senior Manager (HR) gets a total of Rs. 76500 + IDA (Basic Rs. 70000), while Manager (OL) gets Rs. 66000 + IDA (Basic Rs. 60000).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.300/- (non-refundable), paid through SBI Collect or a Demand Draft payable at Chennai; SC/ST/PwD/Ex-SM/EWS/Female applicants are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for AVNL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the filled Annexure A form with self-attested documents and the fee by Speed Post/Courier Service to The General Manager/HR-II (CO), Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited, HVF Road, Avadi, Chennai – 600 054, with the Advertisement No. and post name on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is through a presentation and assessment parameters carrying 85% weightage and an interview carrying 15%.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AVNL job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is fixed term employment for one year, which may be extended up to a maximum of four years including the initial period.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be at Avadi, Chennai or through Video Conference (VC) mode, depending on the number of eligible applicants.
